"""Throwaway repro for ticket #31767: QuerySet.none() on combined queries.

Run with the project root on sys.path (cwd = django checkout root).
Uses the tests.queries app models; sqlite in-memory DB.
"""
import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={'default': {'ENGINE': 'django.db.backends.sqlite3', 'NAME': ':memory:'}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=['django.contrib.contenttypes', 'django.contrib.auth', 'tests.queries'],
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD='django.db.models.AutoField',
)
django.setup()

from django.test.utils import setup_test_environment, setup_databases
setup_test_environment()
old_config = setup_databases(verbosity=0, interactive=False)

from tests.queries.models import Number

Number.objects.bulk_create(Number(num=i, other_num=10 - i) for i in range(10))

qs1 = Number.objects.filter(num__lte=1)
qs2 = Number.objects.filter(num__gte=8)
combined = qs1.union(qs2)

print('union count (expect 4):', combined.count())
print('union.none() count (expect 0):', combined.none().count())
print('none() on plain qs (expect 0):', Number.objects.none().count())
print('union after none() chain (expect 4):', combined.none().union(Number.objects.none()).count() if False else 'n/a')

# The form scenario from the ticket: empty submission -> all objects added
# because ModelMultipleChoiceField.clean() does queryset.none() | ... no --
# it uses qs.none() when nothing selected. Direct check:
empty = combined.none()
print('list(empty) length (expect 0):', len(list(empty)))

# Also check intersection/difference paths
print('intersection.none() (expect 0):', qs1.intersection(qs2).none().count())
print('difference.none() (expect 0):', qs1.difference(qs2).none().count())

# And that none() before union still works (EmptyQuerySet path)
print('none().union(qs2) (expect 2):', Number.objects.none().union(qs2).count())

# Clone independence: none() must not mutate the original combined query
before = combined.count()
_ = combined.none().count()
print('original unchanged (expect 4):', combined.count())
